reference/ma-migrator-capabilities/platforms/hubspot.yaml — extraction.authentication's private-app model ("The standard mechanism for a single-tenant integration"), gap patterns ads_audience_sync and forms_and_ctas_rebuild, and object_catalog.audiences.ads_audiences, whose gloss is the reason connected ad accounts are counted separately from apps: "The sync connection itself is a live integration, not an asset." The base wording ("Basic native CRM sync only ... Custom REST/SOAP integrations") describes a Marketing Cloud estate; HubSpot's equivalent surface is the app marketplace plus private apps, and asking it in SOAP terms produced an answer about a protocol nobody uses here. COUNT ONLY, which is the whole point of the recalibration: slot 6 on this pair was moved off counting and onto OWNERSHIP for exactly this reason — a respondent was being asked how many integrations they had twice, three screens apart. Here it is the count; there it is who would have to re-point them.
